subtitle: A stacked beef burger with cheese, maple-cured bacon and chips, suited to diners with a substantial appetite.

components.name: American-style cheese

components.name: Maple-cured bacon

taste:
The burger is dense and beef-led, with two thick patties providing a substantial base and a bold, savoury flavour. Melting American-style cheese adds richness between the layers, while crispy maple-cured bacon gives a contrasting bite. Its soft bun offers a gentler texture around the substantial filling.

Expect a tall stack served with a generous helping of golden chips on the side. This is a meal for a large appetite, with bold beef and rich cheese defining the experience. If you prefer a burger that is less dominated by meat and cheese, that emphasis is worth considering before ordering.
